title: Bạn có thể gõ địa chỉ cho tôi được không?
englishTitle: Can you type the address for me?
pronunciation: Ban co the go dia chi cho toi duoc khong
summary: For handing over your phone so a hotel, shop, or driver can enter the address without spelling mistakes.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Best when the address is long, tonal marks matter, or the map app needs the exact Vietnamese name.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Open the map, note, or message field first. Hold the phone so the other person can type instead of dictate.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gõ địa chỉ cho tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you type the address for me?

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; gõ địa chỉ means type the address; cho tôi means for me; được không softens it.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể gõ địa chỉ cho tôi được không?
breakdown.english: Can you type the address for me?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi, SIM, and charger cards stay nearby if the phone problem changes from typing to setup.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, taxi stands, tour counters, shops, clinics, and anywhere an exact address matters.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Typed addresses reduce wrong pins. Check the result before you leave the counter or start walking.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to battery, charger, charge-here, data-top-up, or eSIM cards if the phone itself becomes the obstacle.
